title: Use an action sheet — not an alert — to offer choices related to an intentional action

statement.en: Choose or apply an action sheet — not an alert — to offer choices related to an intentional action in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではan action sheet — not an alert — to offer choices related to an intentional actionを採用する。

conditions: An alert can confirm or cancel a destructive action but doesn't offer additional related choices.
Alerts are generally unexpected and communicate a problem or situational change.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Action sheets experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるAction sheetsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Use action sheets sparingly

statement.en: Choose or apply action sheets sparingly in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではaction sheets sparinglyを採用する。

conditions: Action sheets interrupt the current task.
Avoid unnecessary use so people continue to pay attention when one appears.

title: Use an action sheet — not a menu — to provide choices related to an action

statement.en: On iOS and iPadOS, use an action sheet instead of a menu for choices related to an action.
statement.ja: iOSとiPadOSでactionにrelatedするchoiceにはmenuではなくaction sheetを使う。

conditions: People expect an action sheet after an action that may need clarifying choices.
People expect a menu only after choosing to reveal it.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Action sheets experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
